moa: calcium channel blocker plus HMG-CoA reductase inhibitor (fixed-dose combination)

approval_evidence.quote: 01/30/2004 ORIG-1 Approval Type 4 - New Combination (NDA 021540, CADUET AMLODIPINE BESYLATE; ATORVASTATIN CALCIUM)

launch_evidence.quote: Caduet, dual therapy of Lipitor (atorvastatin) and Norvasc (amlodipine), was approved by the FDA on January 30, 2004, and achieved sales of $28 million in the first quarter of 2004.

series_end_reason: Pfizer's product revenue tables print a CADUET row through the first-quarter 2014 release (8-K filed 2014-05-05). The second- and third-quarter 2014 releases (filed 2014-07-29 and 2014-10-28) and the 2014 10-Qs print no CADUET row, and the 2015 releases print none either, so 2014Q2 and 2014Q3 are printed nowhere on sec.gov; the row reappears only in the fourth-quarter 2014 release, so the contiguous series ends 2014Q1.
search_log: Listed every filing of CIK 78003 (Pfizer), all forms; fetched every 10-Q/10-K main document and every htm/txt document of every earnings 8-K (items 2.02, and item 12 for 2002-2004) 2002-2026.

Rows read from the first (quarter) product revenues table of each release (plain-text exhibits to 2007, HTML from 2008), Worldwide current-quarter column. The first-quarter 2004 figure (28) is the initial trade sale after the January 30, 2004 approval; Pfizer's July 2004 release reports the promotional launch: 'Caduet ... was launched in May in the U.S.'
Quarter sums equal the full-year figures printed in the Q4 releases: 2004 50; 2005 185; 2006 370; 2007 568; 2008 589; 2009 548.
